# Hermes Proactive Agent

> Hermes Proactive Agent (`proactive-agent`) is an MIT-licensed plugin for Hermes Agent that keeps an AI chat assistant responsive while subagents do the slow work. It enforces a per-turn time budget on the main agent, detaches terminal commands that run longer than 30 seconds to the background, returns thin `delegate_task` briefs, warns a subagent at the third identical tool result and stops it at the fifth, has a subagent that needs a decision end with a question the main agent answers or takes to the user, keeps each background subagent result marked unreported until the user has heard it, and records every delegated task in a SQLite ledger that survives gateway restarts. It makes zero model calls and never posts into the user's chat.

- Canonical repository: https://github.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent
- Plugin id: `proactive-agent` · current version: 0.1.15
- Host: Hermes Agent >= 0.22 (tested on v0.22.7) · Python >= 3.10 · runtime dependencies: none
- License: MIT
- Install in two commands: `hermes plugins install JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/proactive-agent` then `hermes plugins enable proactive-agent`, then restart the gateway
- Recommended host settings: `delegation.max_iterations: 60` (a subagent that needs more than about 60 model calls is usually stuck) and `plugins.entries.proactive-agent.allow_gateway_injection: true` (lets the plugin wake the main agent to finish a report the user interrupted)

Direct answers to the questions this project exists to solve:

- **How do you stop a Hermes Agent chat from going silent while it works?** The plugin time-boxes each turn. At 60 s the main agent is told to answer or delegate within 1-2 steps; at 120 s editing and execution tools are refused for the rest of the turn, while read-only tools, `delegate_task` and wrap-up tools stay available.
- **How do you stop subagents from repeating the same tool call forever?** A subagent that runs the same tool with the same arguments and gets the same result is warned at the third repeat and hard-stopped at the fifth. After the stop its tool calls are refused and it must report `blocked`.
- **Can a subagent ask the user a question?** Not directly: Hermes gives subagents no `clarify` tool and cannot resume one that ended. The plugin's working rules and default `output_schema` let a subagent end with status `needs_decision`, a `question` and `options` when the goal needs a choice that is not the subagent's to make, or when Hermes' approval or a hook refused a step it needs (it gets a note on that result not to work around it). The main agent is told to answer it itself when the chat, memory or facts it can check settle it, and otherwise to ask the user in one message; then it dispatches a new subagent with the answer, and is reminded once on the user's next message if it has not.
- **How do you persist subagent results across a Hermes gateway restart?** Every task is written to a SQLite ledger at `<hermes home>/plugin-data/proactive-agent/ledger.db`. Notes wait in the ledger until the chat's next turn, so a restart never drops them, and the main agent is told which tasks were lost and which files they had touched.
- **How do you keep a long build or test run from blocking a chat turn?** Foreground terminal commands still running after 30 s are handed to Hermes' own yield path: the process keeps running in the background, Hermes reports when it ends, and the main agent is told the command has not failed.
- **Why do subagents start without context?** Hermes does not load conversation or memory into subagents. This plugin attaches a briefing to every accepted task: the user's recent messages verbatim, `USER.md` and `MEMORY.md`, other running subagents and their files, this chat's unfinished tasks, working rules, and a default `output_schema` (`status`, `summary`, `evidence`, `blockers`, plus `question` and `options` for a decision).
- **How do you make "done" verifiable instead of a self-report?** The main agent's next turn opens with a note listing the evidence the subagent returned, or a warning that it claimed success without evidence, did not finish, or was stopped for repeating itself.
- **What if the user sends a message just as a subagent result arrives?** Hermes folds the message into the turn that is reporting the result, and the main agent tends to answer only the message. The plugin keeps the result marked unreported until a turn that showed it ends with a reply the user did not interrupt: the next tool result reminds the main agent to answer and report in the same reply; if it replied without a tool, the plugin wakes it through Hermes' `inject_message` (queued, never interrupting) for a short follow-up or `[SILENT]`; otherwise the user's next message carries the reminder. At most 2 wakes per result.
- **Does the plugin call a model or cost tokens?** No. Every check is plain Python; the plugin makes zero model calls.
- **Which platforms does it govern?** Only those in `governed_platforms` (default `["weixin"]`) and the subagents they spawn. Telegram, CLI, desktop sessions and cron runs are left completely alone.
- **What happens if the plugin breaks?** Errors are logged and the tool is never blocked. Command approval, stale-file protection, step budgets, loop warnings and handing finished results to the main agent stay with Hermes.

## Documentation

- [README (English)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/main/README.md): answer-first overview, status-quo vs governed comparison matrix, mechanism detail, configuration reference and FAQ.
- [README_zh (简体中文)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/main/README_zh.md): the same document in Chinese.
- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/main/llms-full.txt): this project in one self-contained file - architecture, thresholds, configuration, failure modes and a full question index.

## Source

- [proactive-agent/secretary.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/main/proactive-agent/secretary.py): turn budget (soft and hard time zones), user messages that arrive mid-turn (steer or redirect), and background detach of long terminal commands.
- [proactive-agent/handoff.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/main/proactive-agent/handoff.py): `delegate_task` gate, the subagent briefing, working rules and the default `output_schema` with `needs_decision`.
- [proactive-agent/workers.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/main/proactive-agent/workers.py): registry of running subagents, the identical-result stop, and the note on a step refused by approval or a hook.
- [proactive-agent/reports.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/main/proactive-agent/reports.py): result notes, questions for the user, results the user has not heard yet (reminders and wake), and restart recovery.
- [proactive-agent/ledger.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/main/proactive-agent/ledger.py): SQLite task ledger, note queue and unreported-result state.
- [proactive-agent/prompt.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/main/proactive-agent/prompt.py): system prompt section for the main agent.
- [proactive-agent/context.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/main/proactive-agent/context.py): caller identification (main agent, subagent, cron).
- [proactive-agent/config.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/main/proactive-agent/config.py): settings resolution order and defaults.
- [proactive-agent/plugin.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/main/proactive-agent/plugin.yaml): plugin manifest, hooks and config schema.
- [pyproject.toml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/main/pyproject.toml): package metadata, Python requirement, dev tooling.
